clue.text: This implant ultimately mimics bone

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so only the final letter of each word is kept

blocks.note: the last letters of these two words
to ape someone is to mimic them

explanation.surface: A surgeon's implant made to imitate a bone.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is medical, and apt: a stapes prosthesis really is implanted in the ear. 'Ultimately' works on both 'This' and 'implant'.
explanation.definitionFit: The stapes is the tiny stirrup-shaped bone of the middle ear, the smallest in the human body.

clue.text: They might do the conveyancing for your last move

definitions.text: They might do the conveyancing for your last move

blocks.note: surface reading: solicitors handling the legal paperwork when you move house for the final time
setter's reading: physically conveying you, in a coffin, on your final journey to the grave

explanation.walkthrough: Conveyancing is the British legal work of transferring property when you move house; here it is taken literally as carrying, and the last move is your funeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Pall-bearers are the people who carry or escort a coffin at a funeral service.

explanation.definitionFit: In Britain the pavement is the raised walkway beside a road, which is also called a footpath.
